summary: Werner Enterprises filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, disclosing entry into a $1.1 billion unsecured revolving credit facility dated October 5, 2026, replacing its prior $1.075 billion 2022 facility. BMO Bank serves as Administrative Agent, with BMO Capital Markets, Wells Fargo Securities and TD Securities as joint lead arrangers. The facility matures October 5, 2031, retains $100 million letter-of-credit and swingline sublimits, and carried a $465 million initial borrowing at 5.54% (SOFR plus 1.50%). This is a routine credit-facility refinancing, not a special situation; watch covenant leverage terms and any drawdowns tied to M&A.
